title: Test 1
it: Cambridge A2 Key के प्रारूप में अभ्यास: पढ़ना (भाग 1-5) और सुनना (भाग 1-5), अनुमानित अंकों के साथ; लिखना और बोलना नमूनों के साथ अभ्यास करें।

scheme.name: Cambridge A2 Key
scheme.passText: पढ़ना (30 अंक) और सुनना (25), असली परीक्षा जैसे भागों के साथ। A2 के लिए लगभग दो-तिहाई सही जवाब चाहिए: यहाँ सीमा 55 में से 37 है। असली परीक्षा में नतीजा Cambridge English Scale पर आता है (120 से = A2, 140 से = B1) और लिखना व बोलना भी गिने जाते हैं।
scheme.notOfficial: यह Cambridge A2 Key के प्रारूप में अभ्यास है, आधिकारिक परीक्षा नहीं: अंक सिर्फ़ अनुमान हैं। असली परीक्षा में लिखना और बोलना भी है, जिन्हें परीक्षक जाँचते हैं।
scheme.note: असली परीक्षा की तरह, निर्देश और सवाल अंग्रेज़ी में हैं। ज़रूरत हो तो निर्देश हिंदी में देखने के लिए «अनुवाद» दबाएँ।

parts.label: Part 1
parts.inst: For each question, choose the correct answer.
parts.itInst: हर सवाल के लिए सही जवाब चुनिए: पाठ क्या कहता है?

items.text:
SWIMMING POOL
Children under 8 must swim with an adult.
o: Children under 8 cannot use the pool.
An adult has to be in the water with young children.
Adults cannot swim when children are in the pool.
items.e: «must swim with an adult»: 8 साल से छोटे बच्चे किसी बड़े के साथ ही तैरें।

items.text:
Mum,
I'm at Sara's house. Her dad is driving me home after dinner, so you don't need to come and get me.
Love, Ella
o: Ella wants her mother to collect her after dinner.
Ella is going to have dinner at home.
Ella's friend's father will take her home.
items.e: «Her dad is driving me home»: सारा के पापा उसे घर छोड़ेंगे।

items.text:
MUSEUM SHOP
20% off all books — this week only
o: You can buy books for less money this week.
The shop is closed this week.

items.text:
Hi Tom,
The football match on Saturday is at 3 p.m., not 2 p.m. Can you tell the others?
Thanks, Coach Mike
o: Tom needs to call Mike before Saturday.
The match starts later than planned.
The match is now on Sunday.
items.e: 2 बजे की जगह 3 बजे: देर से शुरू होता है।

items.text:
Please do not leave bikes in front of this door.
Use the bike park behind the building.
o: There is a place for bikes at the back.
You can leave your bike here for one hour.
Bikes are not allowed in the building.
items.e: «behind the building» = इमारत के पीछे।

items.text: Hi! The cinema's full tonight. Shall we go tomorrow at 7 instead? Jo
o: Jo has bought tickets for tonight.
Jo doesn't want to go to the cinema.
Jo would like to go tomorrow.
items.e: «Shall we go tomorrow… instead?» = क्या हम उसकी जगह कल चलें?

parts.label: Part 2
parts.inst: For each question, choose the correct answer. Three young people talk about their weekend jobs.
parts.itInst: हर सवाल के लिए सही व्यक्ति चुनिए: A, B या C। तीन युवा अपने वीकेंड के काम के बारे में बताते हैं।
parts.text:
A  Lucy
I work on Saturdays at a café in the town centre. I start at eight, so I have to get up very early, but I finish at two and I have the afternoon free. The best thing is my boss: she's really kind. I don't earn much money, but I get a free lunch every day!

B  Sam
On Sundays I help at an animal centre near my village. I give food to the dogs and I take them for walks. It isn't a job, so I don't get any money, but I love it. I want to be a vet when I finish school, so it's good experience for me.

C  Priya
I've worked in a clothes shop for two years. I work on Saturdays and sometimes on Sunday mornings. I get a lot of money for a student, and I can buy clothes for less. The only problem is that I'm tired on Monday morning at school!

items.q: Who doesn't get paid?
items.e: Sam: «I don't get any money».

items.q: Who has had the job for a long time?
items.e: Priya: «I've worked in a clothes shop for two years».

items.q: Who says something nice about the person she works for?
items.e: Lucy: «my boss: she's really kind».

items.q: Who gets something to eat at work?
items.e: Lucy: «I get a free lunch every day».

items.q: Who knows what job they want in the future?
items.e: Sam: «I want to be a vet».

items.q: Who sometimes works on two days?
items.e: Priya: «on Saturdays and sometimes on Sunday mornings».

items.q: Who has free time after work on the same day?
items.e: Lucy: «I finish at two and I have the afternoon free».

parts.label: Part 3
parts.inst: Read the text and choose the correct answer.
parts.itInst: पाठ पढ़िए और सही जवाब चुनिए।
parts.text:
My first trip abroad
by Daniel Reed

Last summer, my friend Josh and I went on our first holiday without our parents. We were both seventeen, and we wanted to visit Rome. We saved money for a year: I worked in a supermarket and Josh washed cars.

We flew from Manchester on the 2nd of August. The flight was cheap, but it left at six in the morning, so we had to get up at three! When we arrived, it was very hot — 35 degrees. Our hotel was small, but it was near the Colosseum, so we could walk everywhere.

The first day was difficult because we didn't speak any Italian. In a restaurant, Josh wanted fish, but he ordered the wrong dish and got a plate of octopus! After that, people were very kind and helped us, and we learned some useful words.

We stayed for a week. My favourite day was when we went to the beach at Ostia by train. Josh liked the museums more. Next year we're going to visit Florence, and this time we're going to learn some Italian before we go!

items.q: How did the boys get the money for the holiday?
o: Their parents gave it to them.
items.e: «I worked in a supermarket and Josh washed cars».

items.q: Why did they get up at three?
o: The airport was far from their home.
It was too hot to sleep.
items.e: «it left at six in the morning».

items.q: What was good about the hotel?
o: It was in a good place.
items.e: «it was near the Colosseum, so we could walk everywhere».

items.q: What happened in the restaurant?
o: Josh got food he didn't want.
The waiter spoke English to them.
items.e: उसे मछली चाहिए थी, पर ऑक्टोपस आ गया।

items.q: What are they going to do before their next trip?
items.e: «this time we're going to learn some Italian before we go».

parts.label: Part 4
parts.inst: Read the text and choose the correct word for each space.
parts.itInst: पाठ पढ़िए और हर ख़ाली जगह के लिए सही शब्द चुनिए।
parts.text:
The London Eye

The London Eye is a big wheel on the River Thames in London. It (19) ____ in 2000 to celebrate the new millennium. It is 135 metres (20) ____ and, on a clear day, you can see for about 40 kilometres. There are 32 capsules and each one can (21) ____ up to 25 people. A ride (22) ____ about 30 minutes, so you have plenty of time to take photos. Millions of people visit it every year, which makes it one of the most (23) ____ attractions in the UK. It's a good idea to (24) ____ your tickets online, because the queues can be very long.

items.e: «It opened in 2000» = यह 2000 में खुला।
«135 metres high» = 135 मीटर ऊँचा।
«hold up to 25 people» = 25 लोगों तक आ सकते हैं।
«A ride takes 30 minutes» = एक चक्कर 30 मिनट का होता है।
«one of the most visited attractions» = सबसे ज़्यादा देखी जाने वाली जगहों में से एक।
«book your tickets» = टिकट बुक करना।

parts.label: Part 5
parts.inst: For each question, write the correct answer. Write ONE word for each gap.
parts.itInst: हर ख़ाली जगह में एक शब्द लिखिए।
parts.text:
Hi Ana,

Thanks (25) ____ your email! I'm really happy you're coming to visit me next month. I've got (26) ____ great plans for us. On Saturday we can go to the market in the morning and then have lunch at my favourite café. (27) ____ the evening, my brother is playing in a concert, so we can go and listen to him. On Sunday, if the weather is good, we (28) ____ go to the beach. (29) ____ you got a swimming costume? Bring it with you! Let me know (30) ____ time your train arrives.

Love,
Kate

items.e: «Thanks for your email» = आपके ईमेल के लिए धन्यवाद।
«I've got some great plans» = मेरे पास कुछ बढ़िया योजनाएँ हैं।
«In the evening» = शाम को।
«we can go to the beach» = हम समुद्र तट जा सकते हैं (will / could भी सही)।
«Have you got a swimming costume?» = क्या तुम्हारे पास स्विमसूट है?
«what time your train arrives» = तुम्हारी ट्रेन कितने बजे पहुँचती है।

parts.label: Part 1
parts.inst: For each question, choose the correct answer. You will hear each conversation twice.
parts.itInst: हर सवाल के लिए सही जवाब चुनिए। हर बातचीत दो बार सुनाई जाएगी।

script: Did you get a present for your brother, Anna?
Yes. I wanted to buy him a football, but they were too expensive. So I got him a book about football.
items.q: What did Anna buy for her brother?
items.e: «So I got him a book about football»: एक किताब।

script: Excuse me, when's the next bus to the station?
They usually go every twenty minutes, but there's a problem this morning. The next one is at ten fifteen.
items.q: What time is the next bus?
items.e: «The next one is at ten fifteen».

script: Shall we have a picnic tomorrow?
I don't think so. The radio says it'll be cloudy in the morning and then it'll rain all afternoon.
Oh no. Let's go to the museum, then.
items.q: What will the weather be like tomorrow afternoon?
items.e: «it'll rain all afternoon»: बारिश होगी।

script: I can't find my phone! It's not in my bag.
Did you leave it in the kitchen?
No, I looked there… Oh, here it is! It was in my coat pocket all the time.
items.q: Where was the woman's phone?
items.e: «It was in my coat pocket».

script: A coffee, please… No, actually, it's late. I'll have a tea with lemon.
items.q: What does the man order?
items.e: वह मन बदल लेती है: «I'll have a tea with lemon».

parts.label: Part 2
parts.inst: For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one word or a number or a date or a time. You will hear a woman talking about a summer camp.
parts.itInst: ख़ाली जगह में सही जवाब लिखिए: एक शब्द, संख्या, तारीख़ या समय। एक महिला समर कैंप के बारे में बताती है।

script: Hello everyone, and welcome to Riverside Summer Camp. This year the camp starts on Monday the fourteenth of July.
items.q: Camp starts on: Monday ____ July
items.e: «Monday the fourteenth of July».

script: Every day we meet at nine o'clock in the sports hall, next to the swimming pool.
items.q: Meeting place: the sports ____
items.e: «in the sports hall».

script: The camp costs ninety-five pounds for the week, and that includes lunch.
items.q: Price for one week: £ ____
items.e: «ninety-five pounds».

script: Please bring a towel and a water bottle every day. You don't need sports clothes, because we give everyone a T-shirt.
items.q: Bring a towel and a ____ bottle.
items.e: «a towel and a water bottle».

script: If you have any questions, please call Mr Jones. That's J-O-N-E-S.
items.q: For questions, call Mr ____
items.e: नाम अक्षर-अक्षर बोला गया: J-O-N-E-S.

parts.label: Part 3
parts.inst: For each question, choose the correct answer. You will hear Ben talking to his friend Lily about a school trip.
parts.itInst: हर सवाल के लिए सही जवाब चुनिए। Ben अपनी दोस्त Lily से स्कूल ट्रिप के बारे में बात करता है।

script: Lily, have you heard about the school trip?
Yes! Are we going to the science museum again?
No, not this year. We're going to the castle in Warwick.
items.q: Where are they going on the trip?
items.e: «We're going to the castle in Warwick».

script: Great! How are we getting there?
Not by train, it's too expensive. The school has booked a coach.
items.q: How will they travel?
items.e: «The school has booked a coach» (एक बस)।

script: What do we need to take?
Our lunch and some money for the shop. And a jacket, because we'll be outside most of the day.
items.q: What do they need to take?
items.e: खाना, पैसे और एक जैकेट।

script: When do we have to give the form to Mr Brown?
Before Friday. He said Thursday is the last day.
items.q: What is the last day for the form?
items.e: «Thursday is the last day».

script: No, he can't. He's got a football match that day. But his sister is coming.
items.q: Why isn't Sam going on the trip?
items.e: «He's got a football match that day».

parts.label: Part 4
parts.inst: For each question, choose the correct answer.
parts.itInst: हर सवाल के लिए सही जवाब चुनिए।

script: The new Italian restaurant in King Street is lovely. The food's good, but it isn't cheap. What I really love is the garden at the back: you can eat outside in summer.
items.q: You will hear a woman talking about a new restaurant. What does she like most about it?
items.e: «What I really love is the garden».

script: Hello, I've got a room booked for Friday night, but my train arrives very late, after midnight. Is that a problem? Can somebody give me the key?
items.q: You will hear a man calling a hotel. Why is he calling?
items.e: वह आधी रात के बाद पहुँचेगा और पूछता है कि चाबी कौन देगा।

script: I wanted to go shopping on Saturday, but it rained all day, so I stayed at home and watched films with my sister. On Sunday it was sunny and we went to the park.
items.q: You will hear a girl talking about her weekend. What did she do on Saturday?
items.e: शनिवार को बारिश थी: वह घर पर रही।

script: Shall we go to the cinema tonight?
I'm too tired. Why don't you come to my house? We can make pizza.
items.q: You will hear two friends talking. What are they going to do this evening?
items.e: «We can make pizza» उसके घर पर।

script: For homework, please read pages twenty to twenty-five. You don't have to write anything, but there will be a short test on Monday.
items.q: You will hear a teacher talking to her class. What must the students do for homework?
items.e: पेज 20-25 पढ़ने हैं; टेस्ट सोमवार को है, वह होमवर्क नहीं है।

parts.label: Part 5
parts.inst: For each question, choose the correct answer. You will hear Jack talking to his mum about presents for his family. What present will each person get?
parts.itInst: हर व्यक्ति के लिए सही तोहफ़ा चुनिए (A-H)। Jack अपनी माँ से परिवार के तोहफ़ों के बारे में बात करता है।

script: She's got too many books. She loves her garden, so let's get her some flowers.
items.q: Grandma
items.e: किताबें नहीं: बगीचे के लिए फूल।

script: And Uncle Pete? He likes music.
Yes, but he doesn't listen to CDs any more. He's always cold, though. A scarf would be nice.
items.q: Uncle Pete
items.e: अब CD नहीं: एक मफ़लर, क्योंकि उसे हमेशा ठंड लगती है।

script: Sophie wants a T-shirt with a cat on it.
She's got lots of T-shirts. She asked me for a game she can play with her friends.
items.q: Sophie
items.e: उसके पास पहले से बहुत टी-शर्ट हैं: एक खेल।

script: Yes, but I bought him one last year. He's started cooking, so let's get him a book with Italian recipes.
items.q: Dad
items.e: इतालवी व्यंजनों की एक किताब।

script: She doesn't eat sweet things, so not a cake. Let's give her a nice pen. She writes a lot of letters.
items.q: Mrs Clark
items.e: मिठाई नहीं: एक सुंदर पेन।

practice.task: You want to go to the cinema with your English friend, Sam. Write an email to Sam. In your email: say which film you want to see; tell Sam when you want to go; say where you can meet. Write 25 words or more.
practice.tr: आप अपने अंग्रेज़ दोस्त Sam के साथ सिनेमा जाना चाहते हैं। उसे ईमेल लिखिए: कौन-सी फ़िल्म देखनी है, कब जाना है और कहाँ मिल सकते हैं। कम से कम 25 शब्द।
practice.model: Hi Sam, would you like to come to the cinema with me? I want to see the new James Bond film. Shall we go on Saturday evening at seven? We can meet outside the station at half past six. See you soon! Luca

practice.task: Look at the three pictures. Write the story shown in the pictures. Write 35 words or more. Picture 1: a girl is walking in the park and the wind takes her hat. Picture 2: a dog runs after the hat. Picture 3: the dog brings the hat back and the girl gives it a biscuit.
practice.tr: तीन तस्वीरें देखिए और कहानी लिखिए। कम से कम 35 शब्द। 1: एक लड़की पार्क में चल रही है और हवा उसकी टोपी उड़ा ले जाती है। 2: एक कुत्ता टोपी के पीछे दौड़ता है। 3: कुत्ता टोपी वापस लाता है और लड़की उसे बिस्किट देती है।
practice.model: Last Sunday, Emma was walking in the park. It was very windy and suddenly the wind took her new hat. A small brown dog saw it and ran after it. A few minutes later, the dog came back with the hat in its mouth. Emma was very happy and she gave the dog a biscuit.

practice.task: Interview: answer the examiner's questions about yourself. What's your name? Where do you live? Who do you live with? Tell me about your free time.
practice.tr: इंटरव्यू: परीक्षक के सवालों के जवाब दीजिए: नाम, कहाँ रहते हैं, किसके साथ रहते हैं, ख़ाली समय में क्या करते हैं।
practice.model: My name's Marco Bianchi. I live in Bologna, in the north of Italy. I live with my parents and my younger sister. In my free time I play basketball twice a week and I like watching films with my friends. At the weekend I sometimes go to the mountains with my family.

practice.task: Discussion: look at the pictures of different holidays (a beach holiday, a city break, a holiday in the mountains). Do you like these holidays? Which one do you prefer? Why?
practice.tr: चर्चा: अलग-अलग छुट्टियों की तस्वीरें देखिए (समुद्र तट, शहर, पहाड़)। क्या वे आपको पसंद हैं? आपको कौन-सी ज़्यादा पसंद है और क्यों?
practice.model: I like beach holidays because I love swimming, but sometimes it's too hot. City breaks are interesting: you can visit museums and eat in nice restaurants, but they're expensive. I think I prefer holidays in the mountains, because it's quiet and I love walking. Last summer I went to the Dolomites with my family and it was amazing.
